kena_chapter5_verse3.title: Kena Chapter 5 Verse 3
kena_chapter5_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Kena, Chapter 5.
kena_chapter5_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Kena Upanishad, Chapter 5, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
kena_chapter5_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
